# Task P1-09: Bulk add from a pasted list, and the unresolved review

**Phase:** 1 · **Depends on:** P1-07, P1-07b · **Suggested tier:** cheap worker · **Estimated size:** M

## Goal
A user pastes up to 1000 `Artist - Title` lines (or ids/links, one per line); Compilarr stores them as an import list of type `paste`, resolves every line in the background (a command, so progress is visible and the MusicBrainz rate limit is respected), adds all resolved songs **in one batch** (so the album policy can group an artist's songs), and keeps each unresolved line — with its best candidates — in a review state where the user picks a match or skips it. This is the Phase 1 gate's path: "the rest resolve via Deezer or land in an unresolved review state" (DECISIONS "Build session 2" #6).

## Deliverables
Core:
1. `src/Compilarr.Core/Domain/ImportList.cs` — `ImportList : EntityBase` (table `import_list`): `Type` (string, `paste`), `Name`, `Settings` (JSON text, `{}`), `Policy` (string, `AddOnly`), `QualityProfileId` (FK restrict), `LibraryId` (FK restrict), `LastSyncedAt?`; and `ImportListItem : EntityBase` (table `import_list_item`): `ImportListId` (FK cascade), `ExternalId` (string; the 1-based line number for pastes), `SongId?` (FK → song, set null), `Raw` (JSON text `{"line": "...", "artist": "...", "title": "..."}` — artist/title null for non-`Artist - Title` lines), `State` (`ImportListItemState { Pending, Added, Unresolved, Skipped }`, string), `Reason?`, `Candidates` (JSON text, default `[]`: up to 5 `{ source, mbRecordingId, deezerId, title, artistCredit, durationMs, score }`); indexes (`ImportListId`, `State`).
2. Mappings in `src/Compilarr.Core/Persistence/DomainModelConfiguration.cs`, `DbSet`s `ImportLists`/`ImportListItems` on `CompilarrDbContext`, migration `AddImportLists` (`dotnet tool restore`; `dotnet ef migrations add AddImportLists --project src/Compilarr.Core --startup-project src/Compilarr.Core --output-dir Persistence/Migrations`; never hand-written; delete any `design.db`).
3. `src/Compilarr.Core/ImportLists/PasteListService.cs` — `IPasteListService` (scoped):
   - `Task<ImportList> CreateAsync(string text, long? qualityProfileId, long? libraryId, CancellationToken)`: split on `\r\n`/`\n`, trim, drop empty lines and lines starting with `#`; > 1000 lines → `ArgumentException`; name `Pasted list {yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm} UTC` (`TimeProvider`); one `Pending` item per line (`ExternalId` = original line number); a line equal (case-insensitive, after trimming) to an earlier one → `Skipped`, reason "Duplicate of line N". `Raw.artist/title` from `LookupInput.Parse` when its kind is `ArtistTitle`.
   - `Task<string> ProcessAsync(long importListId, Func<string, Task> reportProgress, CancellationToken)`: for each `Pending` item in line order, `IIdentityResolver.ResolveAsync(line)`: `Resolved`/`ResolvedDeezerOnly` → keep the identity; `Unsupported` → `Skipped` with the reason; `Unresolved` → `Unresolved` with the reason and candidates; a `MetadataProviderException` or `HttpRequestException` for one line → `Unresolved` with reason `Lookup failed: {message}` and the loop continues (cancellation still propagates). Report progress after each line (`"Resolved 12 of 50 lines"`). Then **one** `ISongService.AddIdentitiesAsync(all identities, options { QualityProfileId, LibraryId, AddedBy = "list:{id}" })`; each item → `Added` with its `SongId` (reason "Already in the library" for `AlreadyExists`). Save item states as you go (every line) so a restart loses little; set `LastSyncedAt`. Returns `"50 lines: 46 added, 2 already in the library, 1 unresolved, 1 skipped"`.
   - `Task<ImportListItem?> ResolveItemAsync(long itemId, string? mbRecordingId, long? deezerId, CancellationToken)`: `ISongService.AddAsync` with the list's profile/library and `AddedBy` `list:{id}` → item `Added` with the song id (reason cleared); `SongNotFoundException` propagates.
   - `Task<ImportListItem?> SkipItemAsync(long itemId, CancellationToken)` → `Skipped`, reason "Skipped by the user".
   - `Task<ImportListSummary?> GetSummaryAsync(long importListId, CancellationToken)` (counts per state) and `Task<PagedResult<ImportListItem>> GetItemsAsync(PagingSpec, long? importListId, ImportListItemState? state, CancellationToken)` (sort `line` default ascending, `added`).
4. `src/Compilarr.Core/ImportLists/BulkAddSongsCommandHandler.cs` — `ICommandHandler` named `BulkAddSongs`, body `{"name":"BulkAddSongs","importListId":123}` → `ProcessAsync` with `context.ReportProgressAsync`; returns its summary as the completion message. Registered scoped like the Heartbeat handler.

API (namespace `Compilarr.Api.ImportLists`):
5. `src/Compilarr.Api/ImportLists/BulkAddController.cs` — `POST /api/v1/song/bulk` body `{ text, qualityProfileId?, libraryId? }` → `CreateAsync` (400 on empty/too many lines or unknown profile/library) → `ICommandQueue.EnqueueAsync("BulkAddSongs", {"name":"BulkAddSongs","importListId":id}, CommandTrigger.Manual)` → **202** `{ importListId, commandId, lineCount }`.
6. `src/Compilarr.Api/ImportLists/ImportListItemController.cs` + resources — `GET /api/v1/importlist/{id}` → `{ id, type, name, created, lastSyncedAt, counts: { pending, added, unresolved, skipped } }`; `GET /api/v1/importlistitem?importListId=&state=&page=&pageSize=&sortKey=&sortDirection=` → `PagingResource<ImportListItemResource>` `{ id, importListId, line (int), text, artist, title, state, reason, songId, candidates[] }`; `POST /api/v1/importlistitem/{id}/resolve` `{ mbRecordingId? | deezerId? }` (exactly one) → 200 item / 404 / 400; `POST /api/v1/importlistitem/{id}/skip` → 200 / 404.
7. `docs/api/openapi.json` regenerated.
8. Tests: `tests/Compilarr.Core.Tests/ImportLists/PasteListServiceTests.cs` (real SQLite, NSubstitute `IIdentityResolver` and `ISongService`), `tests/Compilarr.Api.Tests/BulkAddApiTests.cs` (factory with the P1-07b override hook; fakes; poll `GET /api/v1/command/{id}` until completed, at most 10 s).

## Constraints
- No new packages. The handler must not hold one `DbContext` across the whole run *and* call into services that use their own — use the scoped services it is given, all from the command's scope.

## Acceptance criteria (each must be demonstrated)
1. `dotnet build -warnaserror` → 0 warnings, 0 errors; `dotnet test` → all pass (paste the summary lines).
2. `CreateAsync` with 6 lines (one blank, one `# comment`, one duplicate differing only in case, one Spotify link, one `Queen - Bohemian Rhapsody`, one `Nobody - Nothing`) → 5 items: the duplicate `Skipped` ("Duplicate of line 1"), the others `Pending`, line numbers preserved; 1001 lines → `ArgumentException`.
3. `ProcessAsync` with a faked resolver (Resolved, ResolvedDeezerOnly, Unresolved with 2 candidates, Unsupported, and one that throws `MetadataProviderException`) → states Added/Added/Unresolved/Skipped/Unresolved, candidates stored, `AddIdentitiesAsync` called **once** with the two identities, progress reported once per line, summary string as specified.
4. `ResolveItemAsync` on the unresolved item → `Added` with the song id; `SkipItemAsync` → `Skipped`.
5. API: `POST /api/v1/song/bulk` → 202 with `lineCount`; the command completes; `GET /api/v1/importlist/{id}` counts match; `GET /api/v1/importlistitem?state=unresolved` lists exactly the unresolved lines; resolve/skip endpoints work; empty `text` → 400; without key → 401; the OpenAPI snapshot test passes.

## Out of scope
- Other import-list types, scheduled syncs, sync policies (Phase 6), UI (P1-11).
